evidence.quote: I would like to welcome everyone to this Third Conference on the International Roles of the U.S. Dollar
The dollar remains, by far, the most widely used currency across a variety of metrics, including as a store of value and a medium of exchange.
The Federal Reserve supports the use of dollars internationally through our liquidity facilities, including the central bank liquidity swap lines
